name: Jarvis - Personal Assistant
description: A Python-based personal assistant that responds to voice commands, executes tasks like Wikipedia search, time, face recognition, email automation, and supports custom commands.
roadmap: Add more NLP capabilities for natural conversations
Improve face recognition with deep learning models

story.origin: Jarvis began during my school days in 12th grade (2020), when I first learned Python programming. Inspired by Marvel movies, I wondered if Sci-Fi could be brought into reality, and Jarvis became my first step towards engineering a real project.
story.journey: The first versions of Jarvis were simple — recognizing speech and replying back using Python libraries. With limited technical knowledge at that time, and without today’s accessible AI tools, I still managed to showcase Jarvis to my teachers. Unfortunately, I couldn’t preserve those early versions, but they marked the foundation of my journey.
story.growth: As I entered college, I explored new technologies and concepts I didn’t even know existed back in school. With each new learning, I tried to integrate more features into Jarvis, from NLP to automation and face recognition.
story.current: Now, I’m completely restructuring Jarvis with a new architecture — rebuilding it with stronger capabilities, practical use cases, and a vision to make it a truly smart personal assistant.
